title: Kubernetes Cluster Health
description: Workload stability, scheduling, node conditions and resource usage.

viz_warning_events.title: Warning Events
viz_warning_events.description: Warning events per namespace with affected objects and reasons.

viz_crashlooping_pods.title: CrashLooping Pods
viz_crashlooping_pods.description: Pods in CrashLoopBackOff (back-off restarting failed container).

viz_oomkilled_events.title: OOMKilled Events
viz_oomkilled_events.description: Containers killed for exceeding memory limits and node-level OOM kills.

viz_unschedulable_pods.title: Unschedulable Pods
viz_unschedulable_pods.description: Pods the scheduler could not place, with the reason (insufficient CPU/memory, taints, affinity).

viz_warning_events_by_namespace.title: Warning Events by Namespace
viz_warning_events_by_namespace.description: Warning events over time per namespace.

viz_restart_signals_by_pod.title: Restart Signals by Pod
viz_restart_signals_by_pod.description: Restart signals (BackOff, Killing, Unhealthy) per pod over time.

viz_cpu_by_pod.title: CPU by Pod
viz_cpu_by_pod.description: CPU utilisation per pod from OpenTelemetry/kubelet metrics.

viz_memory_of_limit_by_pod.title: Memory % of Limit by Pod
viz_memory_of_limit_by_pod.description: Memory working set as a percentage of the container limit, per pod.

viz_crashloopbackoff_details.title: CrashLoopBackOff Details
viz_crashloopbackoff_details.description: Pods in CrashLoopBackOff (back-off restarting failed container).

viz_top_pods_by_restarts.title: Top Pods by Restarts
viz_top_pods_by_restarts.description: Pods with the most container restarts in the period (from k8s.container.restarts metric).

viz_node_conditions.title: Node Conditions
viz_node_conditions.description: NotReady, pressure conditions, reboots and kubelet problems per node.

viz_deployment_failures.title: Deployment Failures
viz_deployment_failures.description: Failed rollouts and controller errors for Deployments/ReplicaSets/StatefulSets/DaemonSets.

viz_scheduling_failures.title: Scheduling Failures
viz_scheduling_failures.description: Pods the scheduler could not place, with the reason (insufficient CPU/memory, taints, affinity).

options.query:
index=k8s_events sourcetype="kube:object:events" object.type="Warning" object.involvedObject.namespace="$namespace$"
| stats count AS warnings

index=k8s_events sourcetype="kube:object:events" (object.reason="BackOff" OR "CrashLoopBackOff") object.involvedObject.namespace="$namespace$"
| stats dc(object.involvedObject.name) AS crashlooping_pods

index=k8s_events sourcetype="kube:object:events" ("OOMKilled" OR object.reason="OOMKilling" OR object.reason="SystemOOM") object.involvedObject.namespace="$namespace$"
| stats count AS oom_kills

index=k8s_events sourcetype="kube:object:events" object.reason="FailedScheduling" object.involvedObject.namespace="$namespace$"
| stats dc(object.involvedObject.name) AS pending_pods

index=k8s_events sourcetype="kube:object:events" object.type="Warning" object.involvedObject.namespace="$namespace$"
| timechart span=15m count BY object.involvedObject.namespace limit=10 useother=true

index=k8s_events sourcetype="kube:object:events" object.involvedObject.kind="Pod" object.reason IN ("BackOff", "Killing", "Unhealthy") object.involvedObject.namespace="$namespace$"
| timechart span=15m count AS restart_signals BY object.involvedObject.name limit=10 useother=true

| mstats avg(container.cpu.utilization) AS cpu WHERE index=k8s_metrics k8s.namespace.name="$namespace$" span=5m BY k8s.namespace.name k8s.pod.name
| timechart span=5m max(cpu) AS cpu BY k8s.pod.name limit=10 useother=true

| mstats avg(container.memory.usage) AS mem_bytes max(k8s.container.memory_limit) AS mem_limit WHERE index=k8s_metrics k8s.namespace.name="$namespace$" span=5m BY k8s.namespace.name k8s.pod.name
| eval mem_pct=if(mem_limit > 0, round(mem_bytes / mem_limit * 100, 2), null())
| timechart span=5m max(mem_pct) AS mem_pct BY k8s.pod.name limit=10 useother=true

index=k8s_events sourcetype="kube:object:events" (object.reason="BackOff" OR "CrashLoopBackOff") object.involvedObject.namespace="$namespace$"
| stats count AS backoffs latest(object.message) AS last_message latest(_time) AS last_seen BY object.involvedObject.namespace object.involvedObject.name
| sort - backoffs
| convert ctime(last_seen)

| mstats max(k8s.container.restarts) AS restarts WHERE index=k8s_metrics k8s.namespace.name="$namespace$" span=5m BY k8s.namespace.name k8s.pod.name
| stats range(restarts) AS restarts_in_window max(restarts) AS total_restarts BY k8s.namespace.name k8s.pod.name
| where restarts_in_window > 0
| sort - restarts_in_window
| head 10

index=k8s_events sourcetype="kube:object:events" object.involvedObject.kind="Node" object.reason IN ("NodeNotReady", "NodeNotSchedulable", "NodeHasDiskPressure", "NodeHasMemoryPressure", "NodeHasPIDPressure", "EvictionThresholdMet", "Rebooted", "SystemOOM", "NodeHasInsufficientMemory", "KubeletNotReady")
| stats count AS events values(object.reason) AS conditions latest(object.message) AS last_message latest(_time) AS last_seen BY object.involvedObject.name
| rename object.involvedObject.name AS node
| sort - events
| convert ctime(last_seen)

index=k8s_events sourcetype="kube:object:events" object.involvedObject.kind IN ("Deployment", "ReplicaSet", "StatefulSet", "DaemonSet") object.reason IN ("FailedCreate", "ProgressDeadlineExceeded", "FailedDelete", "ReplicaSetCreateError", "FailedUpdate") object.involvedObject.namespace="$namespace$"
| stats count AS failures values(object.reason) AS reasons latest(object.message) AS last_message latest(_time) AS last_seen BY object.involvedObject.namespace object.involvedObject.kind object.involvedObject.name
| sort - failures
| convert ctime(last_seen)

index=k8s_events sourcetype="kube:object:events" object.reason="FailedScheduling" object.involvedObject.namespace="$namespace$"
| rex field=object.message "(?<scheduling_reason>Insufficient \w+|untolerated taint|didn't match [^,.]+|volume node affinity conflict)"
| stats count AS attempts values(scheduling_reason) AS reasons latest(object.message) AS last_message BY object.involvedObject.namespace object.involvedObject.name
| sort - attempts
